ratings.note: f: Today is preselected and same-day booking is a stated common case; i: whole flow completed before the rejection, recovery needs going back; p: recurs on every same-day visit but residents learn to avoid early slots. s=3.
f: every Change slot / Back to the slots in a core journey; i: day must be re-found or retyped and a hurried tap books the wrong day (probe 36 shows this); p: recurs per change. s=3.
f: only van/trailer residents without a permit booking near-term; i: wasted day/slot choice and restart; p: learned once per resident. s=2.
f: screen-reader users only, on every step; i: orientation loss, h1 partly compensates; p: not overcome since the state is never exposed. s=2.
f: low-vision residents (common in this population) on most days; i: 'Few left' is supplementary status at ~3:1, still partly legible; p: every visit. s=2.
f: residents whose 5-minute hold lapses (interrupted bookers); i: no reason or link, slot blanked, primary button invites futile retry, may give up; p: Change slot is learnable. s=3.
f: residents whose plans change (core task 2); i: task impossible online, only a weekday office-hours phone call (support contact by definition), none at evenings/weekends; p: every change. s=4.
Same user consequence as the past-slot evidence: f common (Today default), i late rejection after three steps, p recurring but avoidable once learned. s=3.
f: only Another-day users who mistype; i: stale Today slots look valid and can be booked for the wrong day, though the confirm page shows the day; p: one-off. s=2.
f: every day change; i: under a second of blank area and layout shift; p: recurs. s=3; rated 2 because the wait self-resolves in <1 s and the cost is momentary doubt, not error.

f: everyone carries the hold, but expiry hits those who pause (context says often multitasking); i: lost and possibly scarce slot, discovered at the end; p: occasional users forget between bookings. s=3.
f: only when Next is pressed within 0.9 s of a day change; i: silent no-op, a second tap works; p: transient. s=1.
f: van/trailer first-timers; i: help (permit rules, lead time) may be missed behind a bare 'i' icon styled like a vehicle option; p: overcome once learned. s=2.
f: keyboard-only residents (stated group) on every visit; i: verifier screenshots show no ring on the focused slot, risk of choosing wrong time; p: cannot be learned around. s=3.

f: screenshot shows 10 'Few left' tiles (incl. 13:40-16:40) above an unlabelled 'Morning' on most days; i: misgrouping and visual/AT mismatch, times are printed so recoverable by reading each tile; p: recurs each visit. s=3.
Same reordering: f most days, i misread grouping and jumping focus order, p every visit. s=3.
f: every Change slot; i: probe 36 booked Monday 12 instead of Saturday 17 silently, though the confirm page shows the day; p: recurring. s=3. Not 4: confirm summary gives a chance to notice.

f: van/trailer residents without a permit; i: extra search outside the service; p: once per resident. s=1; rated 2 because this group explicitly does not know where the permit comes from and task 3 depends on it.
f: lapsed holds; i: screenshot shows 'This slot is no longer available.' with no action, slot shown as '—', Book button unchanged, so futile retry or abandonment; p: Change slot learnable. s=3.
f: keyboard/SR users who hit vehicle-step errors; i: must tab to the control after following the link; p: learnable. s=2.
f: every booking; i: must recall the slot, wrong slot noticed only at confirm; p: no learning involved, but cost is small each time. s=2.
f: SR users meeting vehicle/waste errors; i: error not announced on focus, summary still lists it; p: recurs. s=2.

f: only cancelled-status views (rare, mostly via the double-tap path); i: 'Booked' heading and gate instructions contradict the red status, wasted trip and gate refusal; p: page reopened at the gate. s=3.
f: every booking; i: 1.5 s with no visible change at the commit step invites repeat taps; p: every submission. s=3.
Same as the no-pending-state evidence: f every booking, i uncertainty and repeat taps, p every submission. s=3.

f: every completed booking; i: done page (kept for the gate, poor signal) lacks day, 20-min window and vehicle; p: lasts to the visit. s=4; rated 3 because the evening-before SMS and the confirm page mitigate, so it rarely blocks.
f: residents whose plans change; i: core task impossible online, phone in weekday office hours only (support contact); p: every change. s=4.
f: cancelled bookings viewed (rare); i: screenshot shows h1 'Booked' plus 'Show this at the gate' under a single red line, so a wasted trip and gate refusal; p: page reused at the gate. s=3.
f: residents taking >5 min (older, multitasking users); i: slot lost without warning or explanation, no way to extend (2.2.1); p: forgotten between infrequent bookings. s=3.

f: nearly every car booking; i: hesitation over an unmarked permit field, though Next proceeds without it; p: occasional users meet it anew. s=3; rated 2 because the cost is a moment's hesitation and the form lets them through.
f: van/trailer bookings without a valid permit; i: '12345' accepted at step 2, error only after all details, not linked to a field on another page; p: recurs per attempt. s=3.
f: every booking, mattering for low-vision residents; i: weak selected-day cue, but the 'Saturday 17 October' caption above the slots gives a text cue; p: recurs. s=2.
f: phones at 360 px or narrower; i: right column clipped or sideways scroll on the slot grid; p: every visit on those devices. s=2.
f: bookers who pause between choosing and booking; i: lost slot and repeated work found only at the last step; p: not remembered between infrequent bookings. s=3.
f: keyboard and switch users on every slot; i: focus invisible on the core choice and on the error path, risk of wrong time; p: cannot be learned around. s=3.
f: every day change; i: ~1 s empty list under the previous day's caption may read as 'no slots'; p: recurs. s=3; rated 2 because it resolves within about a second without user action.

f: double or impatient taps, made likelier by the 1.5 s silent wait; i: screenshot shows the button relabelled 'Cancel booking' and the booking saved as cancelled without consent, so a gate refusal; p: persists in session. s=4.
f: every Change slot or Back; i: day and slot reset to Today, re-entry and wrong-day risk; p: recurs per return. s=3.
